_readme: Where a Boat Show Price request gets emailed, keyed by the dealer name as
A dealer with an address here receives their leads directly, with reply-to
set to the shopper. A dealer with an empty array does NOT lose the lead: it
goes to the show inbox instead, subject-flagged [No dealer address], for a
human to forward. That is the intended behaviour, not a gap to paper over.
ONLY put an address here that the dealer has designated for leads. Several
dealers below have known contacts who have NOT designated one: those people
were outreach addressees for Giselle's boat-list request, and pointing show
leads at them would drop a shopper into an inbox nobody agreed to watch. A
bounced or wrong-inbox lead during the show is worse than the fallback.
Prefer a role address the dealership actually monitors (sales@, info@) over
a single salesperson, so a lead does not die in one person's inbox during
the show. More than one address per dealer is allowed.
Addresses below are transcribed from the Dealer Contacts sheet of the 2026
VBS Boat Inventory Master (r3), which records the source email for each.
Status at 2026-08-30: 6 of 14 dealers designated, covering 82 of 175 boats.
